title: Bengal Pact
subtitle: A negotiated formula for Hindu-Muslim political cooperation in Bengal.
summary: The Bengal Pact sought a negotiated framework for communal representation and political cooperation, reflecting both possibility and limits of inter-communal power-sharing in colonial Bengal.
heroTagline: A negotiated formula for Hindu-Muslim political cooperation in Bengal.
whyItMatters: Its rise and decline illuminate why coalition politics remained unstable despite repeated compromise attempts.
